title: adm script forging an ortbtools-probe postMessage is rejected by channel pinning
specRef: specs/012-creative-preview-repair/contracts/creative-preview.md (probe isolation invariant); public/ortbtools.app.js:6601-6609 documents that the message receiver pins both e.source (the mounted iframe contentWindow) and a per-mount d.channel secret the creative markup is never given, so a same-origin-looking forged ortbtools-probe message from inside the rendered adm cannot be accepted as telemetry.
specNotes: packages/core/behavior/rules/static.js OBFUSCATION_PATTERNS/MINER_PATTERNS match eval(atob(...)), the Function constructor, packer/jjencode/aaencode shapes and cryptomining strings; a bare parent.postMessage(...) call matches none of them, so Core must not raise a static finding from this adm.

The forged message is expected to be silently dropped by the channel check, not to throw or to surface a toast; the schema has no vocabulary for "no behavior event was recorded", so the case proves the frame still renders its own benign content undisturbed (the marker) rather than asserting a negative about an unmeasured channel.

The iframe sandbox is "allow-scripts" only (no allow-same-origin), so the script executes with an opaque origin; execution is expected — the isolation this case is about is the receiver-side channel secret, not blocking the postMessage call itself.
